fact: A paper accepted on 20 October 2026 states that Niamey's addressing still relies on a 2004 plan and that no street-name sign has ever been installed in Yantala, so an address exists only in city documents.
title: Street addressing and street renaming in Yantala (Niamey, Niger): a GIS to inventory public green spaces and track renamed streets
publisher: World Journal of Advanced Research and Reviews
